$Comment: What a member sees when a boss gets away: the fight's script sent zc:escaped before taking it away (a
timer ran out, say, or the party wiped and the script calls that an escape). The run pays nothing and
the boss does not rise again until the binding row's Timing.Rest has passed.
This is the library's own neutral default; a mod's same-named file or the owner layer
replaces it, and the binding row's Feedback.Escaped leaf can point a fight elsewhere.
The moment fires once per member the run saw and carries 'encounter' (the script id), 'title' (the
fight's name in the reader's language), 'members' and 'seconds' (how long the fight lasted). 'player'
is the member it is about.
A plain Info notice, quiet like a wipe. Add a Sound for a sting, or a Broadcast to tell the arena.
